headline: IT Stock Rally | Nifty July 2026 Performance: IT, Consumer Durables and Realty Breathe Life into the Market, Nifty Jumps More Than 2% in July
summary: The Nifty rose more than 2% in July with broad-based gains led by IT, consumer durables and realty stocks. The strength was not limited to large-cap shares, according to Business Standard.
why: The Nifty 50 is the benchmark index of the National Stock Exchange of India, tracking the country's largest listed companies.
